t: Coastal Plain Marsh - Michigan Natural Features Inventory
s: In the saturated soils further from shore is a dense graminoid-dominated zone of bluejoint grass (Calamagrostis canadensis), twig-rush (Cladium mariscoides), coastal flat-topped goldenrod (Euthamia caroliniana), beak-rush (Rhynchospora capitellata), and others. Lastly, many coastal plain marshes contain a temporarily flooded shrub and tree zone with black chokeberry (Aronia prunifolia), buttonbush (Cephalanthus occidentalis), dogwoods (Cornus spp.), and steeplebush (Spiraea tomentosa).
